# Module: `icescopy_inptk_export`

Arranges toolkit concentration and frozen-fraction tables for Icescopy CSV exports.

[Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_export.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Concentration exports use the returned cumulative tables without resampling, with temperature rows and concentration plus lower/upper bounds for each curve. Missing values become empty cells. Frozen-fraction export can follow the toolkit's selected observations. File writing refuses to overwrite an existing path.
